query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Create multimedia travel marketing assets from scripts and stock/generative media, then deliver generated files by email and provide downloadable presentation content.
query_ground_truth.query: find professional pictures for a marketing campaign
query_ground_truth.rationale: The agent needs to find visual assets based on the travel marketing script.

request.query: find professional pictures for a marketing campaign

results.use_case: find professional pictures for a marketing campaign
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Collect a concise product brief (product_type, branding, angles/scenes, styles, variation count, aspect_ratio/output) to drive prompts for GEMINI_GENERATE_IMAGE.
[Required] [Step]: Generate core product shots and variations using GEMINI_GENERATE_IMAGE (iterate prompts until on-brief).
[Required] [Step]: Extract and store hosted URLs from GEMINI_GENERATE_IMAGE (e.g., data.image.s3url) and label/shortlist final variants for Canva/delivery.
[Optional (if you want Canva assets from URLs)] [Step]: Import selected URLs using CANVA_CREATE_URL_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB (starts async uploads).
[Optional (if URL imports started)] [Next Step]: Poll completion and capture asset IDs using CANVA_GET_URL_ASSET_UPLOADS_JOBID (use job.asset.id when job.status='success').
[Optional (if you have local files instead of URLs)] [Fallback]: Upload files using CANVA_CREATE_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB and poll each via CANVA_FETCH_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB_STATUS to record asset_id.

[Optional (if you need layouts like ads/carousels/thumbnails)] [Next Step]: Create branded layouts using CANVA_CREATE_CANVA_DESIGN_WITH_OPTIONAL_ASSET (place assets into correct page sizes; store design.urls.edit_url and design.urls.view_url).
[Optional (if you need downloadable deliverables)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm supported export formats using CANVA_GET_DESIGNS_DESIGNID_EXPORT_FORMATS before starting exports.

[Optional (if you created Canva designs)] [Next Step]: Export using CANVA_CREATE_CANVA_DESIGN_EXPORT_JOB and retrieve download URLs via CANVA_GET_DESIGN_EXPORT_JOB_RESULT; optionally collect feedback via CANVA_CREATE_DESIGN_COMMENT_IN_PREVIEW_API and iterate before re-export.
known_pitfalls: [GEMINI_GENERATE_IMAGE] Hosted URLs (data.image.s3url) may include short-lived query params (e.g., X-Amz-Expires=3600); capture/use promptly for sharing or Canva imports.
[GEMINI_GENERATE_IMAGE] Invalid aspect_ratio/model enums can trigger validation failures; stick to supported values.
[CANVA_CREATE_URL_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB] Returns an async job (often status='in_progress'); asset IDs are not available until polling.
[CANVA_GET_URL_ASSET_UPLOADS_JOBID] Asset ID is under job.asset.id only when job.status='success'; handle non-success states before proceeding.
[CANVA_CREATE_CANVA_DESIGN_EXPORT_JOB] Export is asynchronous; only use download URLs after CANVA_GET_DESIGN_EXPORT_JOB_RESULT reports completion.

GEMINI_GENERATE_IMAGE.description: Generates images from text prompts using Gemini models (Nano Banana). Supports models: 'gemini-2.5-flash-image' (GA stable, fast), 'gemini-3-pro-image-preview' (Nano Banana Pro - advanced with 4K resolution, thinking mode, up to 14 reference images), and 'gemini-2.0-flash-exp-image-generation' (2.0 Flash experimental). Returns one downloadable image per call, or a text-type entry in data.content when no image is produced. Always validate that an image was returned before treating the call as successful. Output formats are raster only (JPG/PNG/WebP); request PNG for transparency. Concurrent usage may trigger HTTP 429/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED — keep concurrency ≤3 and use exponential backoff (1s→2s→4s, ~5 retries). NOTE NEVER EVER TRUE SYNC_TO_WORKBENCH IN RUBE_MULTI_EXECUTE_TOOL

model.description: Model to use for image generation. Options: 'gemini-2.5-flash-image' (GA stable, fast), 'gemini-3-pro-image-preview' (advanced with 4K, thinking mode), 'gemini-2.0-flash-exp-image-generation' (2.0 Flash experimental).

prompt.description: Text prompt for image generation Sensitive, trademarked, or explicit content triggers HTTP 400 (PROHIBITED_CONTENT or IMAGE_RECITATION) with no image returned — rephrase into neutral, policy-compliant language rather than retrying identical prompts.

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds. Default is 300 seconds (5 minutes). Increase for complex prompts or high-resolution images. Minimum 120 seconds, maximum 600 seconds.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for generated image. Not supported by 'gemini-2.0-flash-exp-image-generation' model. Accepted values: '1:1', '4:5', '16:9', '9:16'. Unsupported strings will fail or silently default to 1:1.

category.description: The category of harmful content to filter

threshold.description: The threshold for blocking content in this category

safety_settings.description: Safety filter settings. List of objects specifying content categories to filter and threshold levels. Each setting requires 'category' (HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT, HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH, HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT, or HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT) and 'threshold' (BLOCK_NONE, BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE, BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE, or BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH).

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate (max 32,768). For image generation, images consume tokens based on resolution: 1K/2K consume 1,120 tokens, 4K consumes 2,000 tokens. If set too low, the API may return MAX_TOKENS finish reason with no image. If not specified, the API uses its default which is sufficient for image generation.

CANVA_CREATE_URL_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB.description: Tool to create an asynchronous Canva asset import job from a public URL. Use when you need to import an asset into Canva directly from a publicly accessible URL without S3 choreography.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL of the file to import. Must use HTTPS protocol (e.g., https://example.com/image.png).

CANVA_GET_URL_ASSET_UPLOADS_JOBID.description: Tool to retrieve the status and result of a URL-based asset upload job. Use this after creating a URL asset upload job to check progress and retrieve the uploaded asset ID when successful.

CANVA_CREATE_CANVA_DESIGN_WITH_OPTIONAL_.description: DEPRECATED: Use CANVA_POST_DESIGNS instead. Creates a new Canva design with specified dimensions or from an asset. This endpoint creates a design using either a preset type (doc, presentation, whiteboard), custom dimensions, or by importing an image asset. Returns the design ID, URLs for editing and viewing, owner info, and metadata. The design can be immediately accessed and edited.

title.description: Design title (1-255 chars). Appears in Canva UI and design lists.

asset_id.description: Image asset ID to create design from. Optional if design_type provided. IMPORTANT: Only image assets are supported - video and PDF assets will be rejected by the API with error 'asset_id must belong to an image asset'. Asset IDs are opaque strings with no guaranteed format. To verify an asset is an image before using it here, call CANVA_RETRIEVE_ASSET_METADATA_BY_ID and check that the 'type' field equals 'image'. To upload a new image asset, use CANVA_CREATE_URL_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB or CANVA_CREATE_ASSET_UPLOAD_JOB.

CANVA_CREATE_CANVA_DESIGN_EXPORT_JOB.description: DEPRECATED: Use CANVA_POST_EXPORTS instead. Exports a Canva design to various file formats. This endpoint initiates an asynchronous export job for designs. Supports image formats (PNG, JPG, GIF), documents (PDF, PPTX), and video (MP4). Each format has specific configuration options like dimensions, quality, and page selection. IMPORTANT: This is an async operation. Use GET_DESIGN_EXPORT_JOB_RESULT to poll the job status until completion and retrieve the download URLs for the exported files.
